answer: Hello! I'm ZentroMart's AI assistant. As a ZentroMart Plus member, you will not be charged the reverse pickup fee of ₹49 for returning shoes you don't like. The fee is waived for all returns by Plus members, regardless of the reason.

evidence.title: Reverse pickup and fees
evidence.excerpt: A reverse pickup fee of ₹49 applies to change-of-mind returns of clothing, footwear and bags. The fee is waived for ZentroMart Plus members and for any item returned because it was damaged, defective or wrong.

evidence.title: Benefits
evidence.excerpt: No reverse pickup fee on any return. ZentroMart Plus does not change return windows, return eligibility or refund timelines after initiation.
